name: Nishiwaga (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nishiwaga town emblem in green, light blue and purple: two leaf-like strokes in green and light blue rising from a purple ring.
history: Municipal flag of Nishiwaga, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 November 2005.
